annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/439 of 24 March 2020 on the harmonised standards for in vitro diagnostic medical devices drafted in support of Directive 98/79/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/439 of 24 March 2020 on the harmonised standards for in vitro diagnostic medical devices drafted in support of Directive 98/79/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision publishing references of harmonised standards (sterilisation, quality management, risk management, software life-cycle, etc.) supporting Directive 98/79/EC on in vitro diagnostic medical devices, giving presumption of conformity. Applies until 26 May 2024; not usable for Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of harmonised standards listed in Annex I in the Official Journal.
Repeals Communication 2017/C 389/04, which continues to apply to Annex II standards until 30 September 2021.
Standards under Directive 98/79/EC cannot confer presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
Enters into force on publication and applies until 26 May 2024.
